description: The plot titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature” illustrates how Pass@8 accuracy varies with the sampling temperature for three methods. The x-axis is labeled “Temperature,” uses a linear scale, and spans 0.1 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8),” uses a linear scale, and ranges from about 62.5 to 80.0 with evenly spaced tick marks every 2.5. The On-policy RL series is shown as an orange solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts near 63.5 at temperature 0.1, rises to about 70.0 at 0.2, stays around 69–72 through 0.6, dips to about 67.5 at 0.7, peaks near 75.0 at 0.8, drops to about 71.0 at 0.9, and ends around 73.5 at 1.0. The LUFFY series is a red solid line with star markers; it begins around 76.0 at 0.1, increases to about 78.5 at 0.2, stays near 76.0–77.0 from 0.3 to 0.6, rises to about 79.5 at 0.7 and about 80.5 at 0.8, dips to roughly 78.5 at 0.9, and returns to about 80.5 at 1.0. The SFT series is a teal solid line with downward-pointing triangle markers; it starts near 76.0 at 0.1, declines to about 75.0 at 0.2 and about 74.5 at 0.3–0.4, drops to about 70.0 at 0.5, rises back to about 76.0 at 0.6, falls to about 72.0 at 0.7, increases to about 73.5 at 0.8, dips to about 71.5 at 0.9, and ends near 74.5 at 1.0.
